title: coap_codec host test dir untracked and fails to build (-Werror)
description: lichen/tests/coap_codec/ is untracked in the working tree (added by an earlier session, never committed) and does not compile as a host CMake test: 11 -Werror unused-parameter/unused-variable/set-but-not-used errors in src/main.c (lines 24,25,42,43,65,66,67,70,72,152). Repro: cd lichen/tests/coap_codec && rm -rf build && mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. && cmake --build . (real exit 2). It is the ONLY host-capable coap test (uses tests/cmake/test_common.cmake), so host-side coap coverage is lost until fixed. Either finish+commit it or drop the dir. Not caused by the coap_dtn.c OSCORE migration (coap_dtn.c is not in this target).
